claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual role in Sinners.

Michael B. Jordan was nominated for Best Actor alongside Timothée Chalamet for Marty Supreme, Leonardo DiCaprio for One Battle After Another, Ethan Hawke for Blue Moon, and Wagner Moura for The Secret Agent.
Timothée Chalamet was nominated for Best Actor for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Actor for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was nominated for Best Actor for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was nominated for Best Actor for The Secret Agent.
Michael B. Jordan's victory for Sinners marked his first Oscar win.
The 2026 Academy Awards ceremony was hosted by Conan O'Brien.
